title: ICSE CLASS 3 — Environmental Studies | Seasons Weather Climate

questions.question: What kind of weather do we usually experience in the summer season?

options.explanation: This is the type of weather experienced in winter, not summer.

questions.question: We experience different seasons throughout the year primarily because:

options.text: The moon changes its position around the Earth.

options.text: The Earth revolves around the Sun, and its tilt causes different parts to receive varying amounts of sunlight.

options.text: Plants grow and shed leaves at specific times.

questions.question: Which of the following terms describes the average weather conditions of a place over a long period of time, rather than just day-to-day changes?

options.explanation: Temperature is a component of weather and climate but does not describe the overall average conditions.
Humidity is another component of weather and climate but does not describe the overall average conditions.
Climate refers to the long-term patterns and averages of weather conditions in a region, while weather describes the atmospheric conditions at a specific time and place.
